name: story-loop
title_zh: 拿着已批准的 PRD 一条条自己跑完的交付流水线
tagline_zh: PRD 批完就没人愿意一条条啃了？它按故事逐条研究、写测试、跑验收、审 diff、提交 git。
tagline_en: Once the PRD is approved, it takes each story through research, tests, acceptance checks, diff review, git.
desc_en: Implement an approved user-stories document autonomously, one story at a time, with research, tests, verification, diff review, acceptance checks, git delivery, and optional PR self-review. Use when asked to run the story loop or implement a PRD or stories document end to end.
why_zh: 一次只推进一个故事，做完研究、测试、验收、diff 复查、git 交付才动下一条，节奏可控、每步留痕。
why_en: Advances one story at a time and only moves on after research, tests, acceptance checks, diff review, and git delivery are done.
limit_zh: 前提是已有一份被批准的 stories/PRD 文档，没有它直接停；它只按文档逐条实现，不替你补需求、不设计架构。
limit_en: Requires an approved stories/PRD doc; without it, it stops. It only implements the doc story by story, won't fill in requirements or design.
title_en: An autonomous delivery loop that ships an approved PRD.
